name: Theory page Tabs swap panel content between assessments
description: The Theory page's client-side Tabs component shows the Solstice panel by default and, when the Passage tab is clicked, replaces the panel content with the Passage question — proving the tab actually swaps content rather than only restyling.

planSteps.description: Verify the 'Inside each assessment' section shows a horizontal row of four tabs labelled Solstice, Turing, Pride, and Passage, with the Solstice tab active by default and its panel showing the question 'How do you burn, and which direction is your energy turning?'.

Verify the tab panel content changes to show the Passage question 'Where does your attention sit, and how do you feel about time passing?' and that the earlier Solstice question is no longer visible, confirming the tab click swapped the panel content.
